stance_rationale: The draft is a design proposal, not a verifiable alpha package: alpha_vector, IC diagnostics, alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, factor_engine_proposal.R, and challenge_note are absent. The package therefore fails RF-A7, AX-002, AX-008, and the time-series alpha contract before any substantive alpha approval can be considered.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: Specified qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260517_002 is missing; stage_artifacts/WT_D20260517_002 contains design docs only and no alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, or covariance.parquet.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: No NEGATE_FACTORS or FLIP_SIGN pattern found; package and PIT audit state Z_Score_Aligned usage.
IC history and alpha_scores are pending Forge emission; no artifact proves Usable_Date <= sig_date.
factor_engine_proposal.R is absent; package references features_master.parquet while load_month_factors() is only a future mandate.
m4/DD/vol t-1 lag is asserted in docs, but no implemented alpha artifact or code path was available for verification.

critical_concerns.description: Required alpha evidence is absent: alpha_vector is empty, diagnostics are null, alpha_scores.parquet is missing, weights.csv is missing, and covariance.parquet is missing. This is not a multi-sig_date alpha package and cannot clear the Iter 4 RF-A7 failure mode.

RF-A1 through RF-A6 cannot be cleared because rank_IC, ICIR, sub_stability, sector-neutral retention, recent-vs-full ICIR, Harvey 5-spec t-stat, and DSR are all Forge-pending. A design gate cannot substitute for realized diagnostics.

Artifact lineage is internally inconsistent: alpha_package and feature_allowlist_v2.sha256 claim f1778f6761d25f2c8cd01dba13c47d5af580b9d1d5582aa1ab8459173fff954b, but sha256sum(feature_allowlist_v2.csv) is b3d667517a39e4ebf219988f67c2cc6e22f4fb6350f5d6a5e52976fb4a8fb6ee.

The frozen top-80 feature allowlist appears selected from a 51-sig_date FMP ranking. Unless that ranking was computed only inside each walk-forward train/validation window, the feature selection itself is a full-sample statistic contaminating the 2022-2026 test period.

The AX-007 exception is only asserted. The draft claims EW collapse is not expressible or is a practical impossibility, but score-proportional softmax can still become near-uniform when scores compress, and no weights_v2.csv or HHI series demonstrates non-EW sizing.

PIT compliance is largely future-tense: C14 IC proof, C15 load route proof, C9 lag proof, and C4 accounting lag proof are promised for Forge but not evidenced. PASS_WITH_STRUCTURAL_CAVEATS is not a substitute for artifact-level PIT verification.

The active-weight and TE design is internally fragile: a max-20 long-only portfolio benchmarked to KOSPI200/KOSDAQ150 may not satisfy TE <= 8%, sector active <= 10%, ADV carryover, bounds, and sum constraints simultaneously without violating the max_names or top-K contract. No covariance or optimizer artifact proves feasibility.

Academic mechanism support is too loose for Charter-level approval: references are mostly non-KR, pages are not cited, and the core China/NYSE/futures transfer claim remains empirical speculation until KR walk-forward results exist.

supporting_arguments: feature_allowlist_v2.csv has 80 unique rows and the stated family caps, but the hash mismatch prevents lineage acceptance.
The draft explicitly acknowledges many gates are Forge-pending; that honesty is useful, but it confirms this is not yet a passable alpha artifact.
No exact base auto-flag phrases were found for: 영향 미미, 관행적 허용, 보수적이면 괜찮다, 대부분 결과 동일, 이미 반영되어 있었을 것, 백테스트 기간 충분히 길어 상쇄.

weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is that sorted portfolio learning plus score-proportional sizing makes EW collapse structurally impossible and therefore qualifies for AX-007 before any weights_v2.csv or HHI evidence exists.

Emit weights.csv with per-sig_date max_names, bounds, sum, turnover, liquidity, ADVUsage, sector active, TE, and HHI checks.
Resolve feature_allowlist_v2.csv sha256 mismatch and provide artifact_lineage.json showing write_json then record_lineage order.
Provide IC diagnostics: rank_IC, ICIR, sub_stability, monotonicity, sector-neutral retention, recent-3Y/full ICIR, Harvey 5-spec t_NW, and DSR.
Prove feature selection PIT: either fold-specific feature allowlists or evidence that the frozen top-80 was selected without using future test information.
